issues.t: Loose timing-case dowel pin ("killer dowel pin")
issues.sym: A ticking or rattling from the front of the engine, then possibly a loud clatter, a coolant leak or a dead engine.
issues.why: A small dowel pin behind the timing cover can work loose and drop into the timing gears, where it can chew them up or punch a hole in the timing case. Trucks of these years were badged Dodge Ram 3500.
issues.next: If it has never been done, have a shop fit a retaining tab over the pin. It is a cheap job that prevents a very expensive failure.

issues.t: VP44 injection pump failure (weak lift pump)
issues.sym: Hard starting, stalling, a sudden loss of power, or a dead engine with a pump communication code.
issues.why: The electronic VP44 injection pump is cooled and lubricated by fuel. A weak engine-mounted lift pump starves it, and it overheats and fails.
issues.next: Have the fuel pressure checked; low lift pump pressure warns of trouble. Replace a weak lift pump early, and expect to replace the VP44 if it has already failed.

issues.t: Cracked "53" engine block
issues.sym: Coolant leaking down the driver side of the block, a falling coolant level, or coolant in the oil.
issues.why: Some blocks cast with the number 53 on the side have thin water-jacket walls that can crack.
issues.next: Look for "53" cast on the driver side of the block. If coolant is leaking, have the block inspected; some cracks can be sealed, others need a replacement engine.

issues.t: Automatic transmission slipping or losing overdrive (47RE)
issues.sym: Slipping, flaring revs between shifts, overdrive that drops out, or a transmission that overheats when towing.
issues.why: The 47RE automatic behind the Cummins and V10 is heavily loaded in these trucks, and its clutches and overdrive section wear out, especially with towing or added power.
issues.next: Check the fluid level and smell. If it slips, stop towing and get it diagnosed; a rebuild with heavy-duty parts is the usual fix.

issues.t: Dashboard top cracks and crumbles
issues.sym: Long cracks in the top of the dash, sometimes pieces breaking away near the defroster vents or behind the steering wheel.
issues.why: The dash material on these trucks shrinks and becomes brittle after years of sun and heat. It is the most-reported complaint for the 2003 model, which was still badged Dodge Ram 3500 (the Dodge name was dropped from 2010).
issues.next: A molded dash cover hides the cracks cheaply. Replacing the dash pad is a much bigger job.

issues.t: Hood can open unexpectedly (recall)
issues.sym: The hood pops up or flutters at speed if it was not fully latched.
issues.why: If the main latch is not engaged, the safety catch may not hold the hood down. Chrysler fixed this under recall 01V-040.
issues.next: Always push the hood down until it clicks. Check the VIN for open recalls with a Ram dealer.

issues.t: Clutch fluid line can leak onto the exhaust (recall)
issues.sym: Smoke or a burning smell under the truck, or a soft clutch pedal on manual-transmission trucks.
issues.why: The hydraulic clutch line could leak fluid onto the hot exhaust, which can start a fire. Chrysler covered it under recall 99V-115.
issues.next: If you smell burning fluid, stop and check under the truck. Have a dealer confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: Driver air bag can be disabled by the clockspring (recall)
issues.sym: The air bag warning light stays on, and the horn or steering wheel buttons may stop working.
issues.why: Material inside the clockspring (the coiled wiring behind the steering wheel) could break its ribbon, cutting the driver air bag circuit. Recall 01V-153 covers it.
issues.next: Do not ignore an air bag light. Have the clockspring checked and confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: Violent front-end shake ("death wobble")
issues.sym: After hitting a bump at highway speed the steering wheel and whole front end shake violently until you slow almost to a stop.
issues.why: The solid front axle relies on a track bar, tie rods, ball joints and a steering damper. When any of these wear or loosen, a bump can set off a shake that feeds on itself. It is the worst-reported problem for the 2013 Ram 3500.
issues.next: Slow down gently without slamming the brakes. Have the track bar, tie rods, ball joints and drag link checked; a new steering damper alone only hides the cause.

issues.t: Left tie rod can break (recalls)
issues.sym: Wandering or loose steering, a clunk in tight low-speed turns, or the left front wheel no longer following the steering.
issues.why: The left tie rod or its ball stud on 4x4 trucks (and some 2wd cab chassis) can fracture, often during tight parking-lot turns. Recalls 13V-528 and 11V-350 replace it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls and have the free repair done. Stop driving if the steering suddenly feels loose.

issues.t: 48RE automatic slipping or failing
issues.sym: Slipping, shudder when the converter locks, lost overdrive, or a transmission that stops pulling. Owners of 2006 trucks report repairs over $7,000.
issues.why: The 48RE four-speed is near its limit behind the Cummins, especially when towing heavy or with added power, and clutches and the converter wear out.
issues.next: Keep the fluid fresh and watch transmission temperature when towing. If it slips, stop towing and get it diagnosed early.

issues.t: Common-rail fuel injector wear
issues.sym: Rough idle, white or black smoke, a miss, knocking, poor mileage or hard starting.
issues.why: The high-pressure injectors on the common-rail 5.9 wear, especially if water or dirt gets past the fuel filter.
issues.next: Change fuel filters on time and drain the water separator. Have a balance-rate or return-flow test done before replacing injectors.

issues.t: Truck can roll out of Park (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter seems to be in Park but the truck creeps or rolls backward, especially if you hop out with the engine running.
issues.why: On diesel trucks with automatic transmissions the park pawl may not fully engage. Chrysler added an out-of-Park warning alarm under recall 05V-462.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and turn the engine off before leaving the truck. Confirm the recall was done.

issues.t: A/C stops blowing cold
issues.sym: Warm or weak air from the vents, or the A/C light is on but the compressor never kicks in.
issues.why: Owners report failed compressors and clutches, and power faults from the main fuse/relay module that stop the compressor clutch from getting power. A/C is the top complaint for the 2006 Ram 3500.
issues.next: Have the shop check that the compressor clutch is getting power before replacing the compressor.

issues.t: Takata front air bag inflator can rupture (recalls)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash. In a crash an inflator can burst and throw metal pieces at the people in front.
issues.why: Takata driver and passenger air bag inflators in these trucks can break down with age, heat and humidity. Several recalls (including 15V-312, 15V-313, 16V-352 and 19V-018) cover them, and 2009 trucks got a do-not-drive warning (18V-021).
issues.next: Check your VIN today and get the free replacement. If your truck is under a do-not-drive notice, have it towed to the dealer.

issues.t: EGR cooler leaking coolant into the engine
issues.sym: Coolant level drops with no outside leak, white steamy exhaust, or overheating.
issues.why: The cooler that chills recirculated exhaust can crack inside, letting coolant into the intake or exhaust.
issues.next: Have a cooling-system pressure test done. Fix it promptly, because coolant in the cylinders can damage the engine.

issues.t: Diesel particulate filter clogging and fuel in the oil
issues.sym: Frequent regenerations, an exhaust filter message, lost power and a rising oil level.
issues.why: Short trips and idling fill the soot filter, and the extra fuel used to burn it clean can thin the oil.
issues.next: Give the truck regular highway runs, use low-ash diesel oil and fix any injector or EGR fault that adds soot.

issues.t: Variable-geometry turbo sticking
issues.sym: Low boost, sluggish acceleration, overboost codes or limp mode.
issues.why: Soot builds up on the sliding vanes of the turbo, so they stick.
issues.next: A shop can try a cleaning procedure first. If the vanes or actuator have failed, the turbo is replaced.

issues.t: Intake heater grid bolt can loosen and fall into the engine
issues.sym: Often none until damage, then knocking, misfire or sudden engine damage. Sometimes a grid-heater warning code first.
issues.why: Bolts holding the electric air heater in the intake can loosen, and a part can be drawn into a cylinder.
issues.next: Ask a diesel shop to inspect the grid heater; many owners fit an upgraded delete plate or secured heater.

issues.t: High-output alternator can fail suddenly (recall)
issues.sym: Battery warning light, dimming lights, or the engine stalling without warning.
issues.why: The 220-amp alternator fitted to 2007-2013 Ram 3500 cab chassis and 2013 pickups can fail suddenly or short circuit. Recall 16V-739 replaces it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. If the battery light comes on, get off the road safely.

issues.t: DEF / SCR system faults and NOx sensor failures
issues.sym: Check-engine and DEF warnings, a countdown to reduced speed, and sometimes a DEF pump that stops working.
issues.why: NOx sensors, the DEF pump, heater and level sensor in the exhaust cleanup system fail with age and heat. A DEF pump that quit is a top complaint for the 2015 Ram 3500.
issues.next: Read the codes promptly; the speed limit can kick in after a few starts. Ask if the federal emissions warranty still covers the part.

issues.t: Water pump can leak coolant (recall)
issues.sym: Coolant drips at the front of the engine, a sweet smell, or a dropping coolant level.
issues.why: Some Concentric water pumps were built without a vent hole and can leak, which raises the risk of an engine-bay fire. Recall 17V-562 replaces them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and keep an eye on the coolant level.

issues.t: Drag link nut can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Loose or wandering steering, or a clunk when turning.
issues.why: The jam nut on the steering drag link can back off, letting the link separate. Recall 19V-021 secures it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have the steering linkage inspected.

issues.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake pressed (recalls)
issues.sym: You can move the shifter out of Park without pressing the brake pedal.
issues.why: A pin in the brake-shift interlock can stick, so the truck could roll away if bumped out of Park. Recalls 17V-821 and 18V-100 fix it.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake. Check your VIN for the recalls.

issues.t: Tailgate can open while driving (recalls)
issues.sym: The tailgate drops open on its own, sometimes while moving.
issues.why: On 2013-2018 trucks a tab in the tailgate latch actuator can break, and on 2019-2022 trucks the tailgate strikers can be misaligned. Recalls 18V-486, 19V-347 and 22V-904 cover them.
issues.next: Make sure the tailgate is latched before driving with cargo, and run your VIN for the recalls.

issues.t: Hemi lifter and camshaft wear
issues.sym: A ticking that does not go away, a misfire or check-engine light, and eventually a rough-running engine.
issues.why: Lifter rollers in the Hemi can seize and wear a lobe on the camshaft. A class action covers 5.7 and 6.4 Hemi engines.
issues.next: Have a ticking Hemi checked early; catching a bad lifter before it ruins the camshaft keeps the bill lower.

issues.t: Side curtain air bag inflator can rupture (recalls)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash. In a crash the curtain air bag inflator can burst and throw metal pieces.
issues.why: The side curtain air bag inflators in these trucks can rupture when deployed. Recalls 25V-010, 25V-592 and 25V-824 replace them.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free replacement.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden stall, no restart, or a loss of power, sometimes with metal in the fuel filter.
issues.why: The Bosch CP4 high-pressure pump can wear and fail, spreading metal through the fuel system. Recall 21V-880 covers some 2019-2020 Ram 3500 trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. If the truck stalls, have it towed rather than cranking it repeatedly.

issues.t: Transmission fluid can spray from the dipstick tube (recalls)
issues.sym: Smoke or a burning smell from under the hood, or red fluid on the engine and exhaust.
issues.why: Heat and pressure in the heavy-duty automatic can push fluid out of the dipstick tube onto hot parts, a fire risk. Recalls 20V-043 and 22V-835 cover it.
issues.next: If you see smoke, pull over and turn the engine off. Check your VIN for the recalls.

issues.t: Intake air heater relay can short and start a fire (recalls)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke under the hood, sometimes with a hard cold start.
issues.why: The relay that powers the intake air heater can short circuit. Recalls 21V-163, 21V-798 and 23V-060 cover it, and owners were told to park outside until fixed.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the recall is done.

issues.t: Driver air bag may not deploy because of the steering column module (recalls)
issues.sym: Air bag warning light, or no warning at all.
issues.why: A fault or poor weld in the steering column control module can stop the driver air bag from working as intended. Recalls 25V-765 and 24V-199 cover it.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free repair.

issues.t: High beams or turn signals act up (recall)
issues.sym: High beams switch on or off by themselves, or turn signals behave wrongly or will not cancel.
issues.why: A fault in the steering column control module affects the light switches. Recall 23V-799 covers it.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the dealer do the free fix.

issues.t: Instrument cluster display can go blank (recalls)
issues.sym: The gauge cluster screen goes dark, so you lose speed and warning lights.
issues.why: A software fault can blank the instrument cluster. Recalls 25V-826 and 26V-225 cover it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the free software update.

issues.t: Trailer lights and trailer brakes may fail (recall)
issues.sym: Trailer brake or trailer light warnings, or trailer lights and brakes that stop working.
issues.why: A fault in the trailer tow module can cut the trailer lights and trailer brakes. Recall 26V-059 covers it.
issues.next: Do not tow until the recall is done, or check the trailer lights and brakes before every trip.

issues.t: Brake warning light can show wrongly (recall)
issues.sym: The brake warning light comes on or behaves wrongly on the dash.
issues.why: The instrument panel can show an incorrect brake warning. Recall 25V-530 covers it.
issues.next: Have the brakes checked if the light comes on, and run your VIN for the recall.
